programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Happu accuses Manmohan of drunk-driving after Manmohan crashes into him. Later, when Happu tells Angoori about the accident, Angoori reveals that the crash was actually her fault.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Tiwari and Vibhuti face a difficult fast while dealing with household chores and false alarms. Between a fake fire and a sprained leg, the day ends with a surprising discovery at home.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti's dinner with Angoori is ruined by a secret agent, while Manmohan's lie is exposed, and Vibhuti breaks Manmohan's phone after overhearing about Angoori's firework fear.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti suffers a head injury and loses his memory after a freak accident involving Angoori. He refuses to recognise anyone, leaving Anita and Tiwari to deal with the chaotic consequences.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Manmohan tries to take advantage of Vibhuti's memory loss and tells him that he comes from a far-off place. Meanwhile, Inspector Happu agrees to look for Vibhuti.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Tiwari and Vibhuti protest the construction of a flyover in front of their houses since it would prevent them from looking at Anita and Angoori from their balconies.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti and Manmohan attempt to halt the construction of a new flyover in their neighborhood. After their initial plans fail, Manmohan begins a hunger strike.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Manmohan's hunger strike fails miserably after he sneaks biryani from Saxena's party. Things worsen when Amma Ji forcibly feeds him more, leading Dr. Gupta to diagnose him with overeating.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Saxena asks Manmohan to take care of his trophy, which he won for his work as a writer. Vibhuti refuses to accept Manmohan's claim of being a great writer.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Angoori hides Manmohan's award while he sleeps, and Happu demands midnight stories for his kids. Meanwhile, Anita assesses Manmohan's career as Vibhuti pressures Angoori into an evening plan.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti persuades Angoori to have a candlelight dinner with him. Later, Manmohan informs Anita that he was not telling the truth.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Manmohan complains about Vibhuti breaking his phone while Anita loves fireworks, but Vibhuti opposes them. Angoori faints from fireworks and mentally becomes a child, not recognising anyone.

programme.desc: Television celebrities team up for stand-up acts and skits, entertaining judges and audiences while competing for the coveted title.

programme.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
programme.desc: Sarika flees to Happu's home after a heated dispute with her husband Raju. While attempting to resolve the pair's marital woes, Happu finds himself landing in hot water.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti tells Angoori that Manmohan is mad and she would be in a fix if he fell for another woman in London. A worried Angoori tells Vibhuti that she will speak to her mother-in-law.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Saxena spikes Vibhuti's drink to seek revenge for a lie and blackmails him with a video. Later, Vibhuti is forced to tease Angoori to prevent his wife from seeing the incriminating footage.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Saxena coerces Vibhuti into teasing Angoori and ruining Anita's hair with gum. To hide his actions, Vibhuti blames a priest's orders, but the truth begins to unravel when Anita informs Manmohan.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Saxena forces Vibhuti to smear mud on Manmohan's face and slap Happu. Later, Vibhuti apologises to everyone after the torment ends, but he unexpectedly repeats his antics on Manmohan.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Anita intends to end her marriage until Saxena explains the truth behind Vibhuti's actions. Meanwhile, Angoori houses three homeless men, causing an argument with Manmohan.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti spikes food in revenge and later gets thrashed while sneaking into Angoori's room. Meanwhile, Manmohan joins Saxena's protest against builders, leading to chaotic clashes.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti and Manmohan evict the trio after they reclaim their homes. Later, Manmohan discovers a sleepwalking Anita on his sofa while Vibhuti pretends to be an astronaut to impress Angoori.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti wears a spacesuit to converse with his neighbor Angoori. Meanwhile, Manmohan consults a doctor regarding Anita's sleepwalking.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: After Vibhuti pretends to be an astronaut to impress Angoori, Happu mistakes him for a criminal in a spacesuit. To keep up the ruse, Vibhuti has Saxena pose as a Martian to delight Angoori.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: After Tiwari ruins the ending of a mystery novel for Anita, she agrees to host the author, Abhay. Later, Abhay begins writing a new story that strangely mirrors the lives of the local residents.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: As Abhay narrates his novel, the events eerily come to life when Martha attacks Vibhuti. While Anita realizes Martha is a character from the book, Saxena causes more chaos dressed as Hilda.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
